title: Sortable item
summary: One row of a pk-sortable: drag its handle (pointer or touch) to reorder, or focus the row and press Alt+Up/Alt+Down. Place it directly inside a pk-sortable.

props.name: value
props.description: The identifier pk-sortable reports for this row in a pk-reorder event's order and item.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Cannot be grabbed, dropped on, or moved by the keyboard.

props.name: dragging
props.description: Set by the surrounding pk-sortable while this row is the one being dragged.

props.name: dropIndicator
props.description: Set by the surrounding pk-sortable to draw the insertion line above or below this row while another row (or an external drag) hovers next to it.

events.name: pk-sortable-grab
events.description: The handle was pressed (pointerdown); consumed by the parent pk-sortable to start a drag. Not cancelable.

events.name: pk-sortable-drag
events.description: The handle is moving while it holds pointer capture; consumed by the parent pk-sortable to update the drop position. Not cancelable.

events.name: pk-sortable-drop
events.description: The handle released the pointer (or the drag was cancelled); consumed by the parent pk-sortable to finish or abandon the drag. Not cancelable.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The row: the handle and the content, side by side.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The drop-indicator line, shown above or below the row by dropIndicator.

parts.name: handle
parts.description: The grab handle: a 44px touch target on a touch screen, decorative to assistive technology (the row itself carries the semantics).

a11y: role=listitem with aria-roledescription="Draggable item" and aria-disabled through ElementInternals. The handle is aria-hidden (decorative, pointer and touch only); the row itself is the tab stop pk-sortable manages (roving tabindex) and the one that responds to Alt+Up and Alt+Down.
